purpose: Licensed intentional divergences across the SDK/CLI/MCP surfaces: schema kinds (extra-param, widened-type, name-for-id, omitted-param) plus the cross-surface behavior kind. Every divergence a checker can observe must carry a license entry here; an unlicensed divergence reds, and a license entry with no matching divergence in the code (rot) reds too, in both directions. This file was created ahead of its checker (P6): the schema-kind entries and their consumer (scripts/check-mcp-schema-parity.mjs) land with W2; only the behavior-kind seeds below are populated now.

entries.reason: The CLI's delete command for an active project or client archives it first, then deletes, via wrapper/ensure.ts's archiveThenDelete core (archiveThenDeleteProject / archiveThenDeleteClient) -- the Clockify API rejects deleting an active project or client directly. SDK and MCP callers building on the raw API surface do not get this chain automatically; only the CLI's delete command wires it in. (Tasks do not have this chain; an earlier plan draft named tasks alongside projects/clients -- verified against the current cli/src/commands/*.ts and corrected here.)

entries.operationOrFamily: name-for-id resolver family (every tool accepting a name in an id slot)
entries.reason: When a resolver name-to-id lookup is ambiguous or unknown, the MCP surface returns a grounded clarification receipt (real candidate ids, a question, and it never reaches the write or list API) instead of guessing or failing opaquely. SDK and CLI resolvers do not have this stop -- they either resolve deterministically or throw.

entries.operationOrFamily: risky write tools (business writes, external side effects, privileged writes, destructive writes)
entries.reason: Every MCP tool whose confirmation metadata is preview_token requires a dry_run call first, returning a confirm_token bound to a hash of the preview and the business args; the real write is refused without a matching, unexpired, unused token. SDK and CLI writes execute directly with no preview/confirm handshake.
